subject: unable to install rstan under g++, O=0

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: unable to install rstan under g++, O=0
parts:
I have a similar problem with rstan when built with O0, and I found it is related to this about bin/print. 

In a cpp file that will be compiled once for the package, I have included 
stan/math/matrix.hpp, which then will include 

stan/math/matrix/dist.hpp
stan/meta/traits.hpp
stan/agrad/rev/var.hpp
stan/agrad/rev/vari.hpp
stan/agrad/rev/var_stack.hpp

So in other words, some symbols in var_stack.hpp will be needed, but we are not compiling var_stack.cpp.  So I have a problem with loading rstan.so like 

** installing vignettes
** testing if installed package can be loaded
Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : 
  unable to load shared object ’/tmp/Rtmp5VpyGo/Rinst367350f9ce29/rstan/libs/rstan.so':
  /tmp/Rtmp5VpyGo/Rinst367350f9ce29/rstan/libs/rstan.so: undefined symbol: _ZN4stan5agrad10var_stack_E

Error: loading failed
Execution halted

This undefined symbol is
$ c++filt  _ZN4stan5agrad10var_stack_E
stan::agrad::var_stack_

This is the commit that Danial pointed out:
https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/commit/34e132354635d4b0c29406a5f4d2197dc4ea37d9


--
Jiqiang

I'll fix it.
